findings.title: AWS Access Key ID detected
findings.description: A likely AWS Access Key ID was found in `src/config.py` at line 9. Committed secrets can be exploited by anyone with repo access.
findings.recommendation: Remove the secret from source code. Rotate it immediately. Use environment variables or a secrets manager instead.

findings.title: Source map file in publish directory
findings.description: Source map `dist/app.js.map` is in a publish directory. Source maps reveal original source code if shipped to production.
findings.recommendation: Exclude `*.map` files from the published bundle, or strip the `sourceMappingURL` reference before publishing.

findings.title: Risk-sensitive area changed: eval() or exec() usage
findings.description: `src/server.js` line 24 touches a risk-sensitive area (eval/exec). This is not a confirmed vulnerability — human review is recommended.
findings.recommendation: Replace eval/exec with safer alternatives (JSON.parse, dispatch tables, explicit validation).

findings.title: Source changes without test changes
findings.description: 3 source file(s) changed but no test files were modified. Changed files include: `src/auth.py`, `src/server.py`, `src/db.py`
findings.recommendation: Add or update tests to cover the changed code. Untested AI-generated code is a common source of bugs and regressions.

findings.title: AI-generated code comment
findings.description: `src/utils.js` line 1 contains a comment marking the file as AI-generated. Useful as provenance; informational only.
findings.recommendation: Review AI-generated code for correctness and security implications before merging.
